source.sha256_method: sha256 over 5 tables' full unfiltered COPY (ORDER BY code[, additional columns]) WITH (FORMAT CSV) output, each preceded by a 'TABLE:<schema>.<table>' header line, concatenated in fixed alphabetical order: nq_basicdata.stock, nq_corpact.stockcons, nq_corpact.stocksplit, nq_dividendinfo.dividendinfo, nq_sharebuyback.daily_data
source.reuse_note: nq_basicdata.stock content overlaps byte-for-byte with the batch already pinned by security_master/security_profile/financial_facts/quote_snapshot, but this promotion's own correctness argument depends on the exact 5-table set it reads together (entity scope x 4 action-source tables), so it mints its own self-contained batch rather than cross-referencing another promotion's pin -- same reasoning quote_snapshot and financial_facts each used for their own batches.

promotion.serving_dataset_domain_note: dataset 'corporate_actions' (plural, matching packages/corporate-actions) vs domain 'corporate_action' (singular, exact CHECK match against aiphabee_core.serving_dataset_domain_check) -- the same plural/singular naming mismatch financial_facts already has, not a domain substitution.
promotion.new_index_required_reason: entity_id lookup uses the leading prefix of the existing serving_record unique index (serving_snapshot_id, entity_type, entity_id, ...)

rights_basis.distinct_from_quote_snapshot: quote_snapshot deliberately uses its own 'netquity-market-data-staging.v1' policy version because market-data Web distribution rights were confirmed separately; corporate actions have no comparable separate rights determination and are covered by the original Netquity collaboration rights approval already used by security_master/security_profile/financial_facts, so this promotion reuses 'netquity-collaboration-staging.v1' rather than minting a new policy version.
rights_basis.account_context_independence: unlike quote_snapshot, resolveCorporateActions filters aiphabee_governance.data_entitlement/aiphabee_core.serving_dataset by context.rights_policy_version (the account's platform.workspace_product_access.policy_version), the same as resolveProfile/resolveFinancialFacts -- no hardcoded policy-version constant is introduced.

action_type_source_mapping.vendor_source: nq_sharebuyback.daily_data (one row per disclosed buyback day)

excluded_from_this_cut.dividendinfo_catype_SC: 39 rows, 'Share Consolidation' -- 38 of the 39 are verified byte-identical (code, announcedate, ratio text) to nq_corpact.stockcons rows and are sourced authoritatively from stockcons instead of double-counting a mirrored row from the dividends feed; the 39th, code 8021 (announced 2026-02-06), has a NULL exdate and no corresponding nq_corpact.stockcons row -- an announced-but-not-yet-effective event that exists only in the dividend feed, excluded under the same missing-exdate discipline as dividendinfo_missing_exdate below, not a duplicate.
excluded_from_this_cut.dividendinfo_catype_SS: 4 rows, 'Share Subdivision' -- 3 of the 4 are verified byte-identical (code, announcedate, ratio text) to the 3 nq_corpact.stocksplit rows and are sourced authoritatively from stocksplit instead; the 4th, code 2477 (announced 2026-03-25), has a NULL exdate and no corresponding nq_corpact.stocksplit row -- an announced-but-not-yet-effective event that exists only in the dividend feed, excluded under the same missing-exdate discipline as dividendinfo_missing_exdate below, not a duplicate.
excluded_from_this_cut.dividendinfo_catype_RS: 36 rows, 'Rights Issue' -- no CorporateActionType enum value in scope for this cut (task-scoped source-table list names only dividend/buyback/split/consolidation); not promoted, not mapped to the existing CorporateActionToolType 'rights' value to avoid expanding scope beyond the named source tables.
excluded_from_this_cut.dividendinfo_catype_OD: 20 rows, 'Other Distribution' -- heterogeneous free-text events (assured entitlements, distributions in specie) with no clean 1:1 enum mapping.
excluded_from_this_cut.dividendinfo_catype_BS: 1 pure-BS row plus the BS leg of 4 'CD,BS' rows, 'Bonus Share' -- no existing CorporateActionType/CorporateActionToolType value for a non-cash stock dividend; the CD leg of a 'CD,BS' row is still promoted as a dividend action, only the BS leg is skipped.
excluded_from_this_cut.dividendinfo_catype_CD_no_dividend: 678 of 1600 'CD' rows are literally 'No Dividend' announcements (dividend column NULL) -- an explicit non-event, not a zero-amount dividend; excluded by the dividend IS NOT NULL filter.
excluded_from_this_cut.dividendinfo_missing_exdate: 1 CD-leg row and 3 SD-leg rows have dividend/specialdividend populated but a NULL exdate with no other populated date to use as effectiveDate -- excluded rather than backfilling a synthesized date. Two further dividendinfo rows are NULL-exdate and dividend-feed-only under this same discipline: catype 'SC' code 8021 and catype 'SS' code 2477 (see dividendinfo_catype_SC / dividendinfo_catype_SS above) -- already counted in those two buckets, cross-referenced here only so the exclusion rationale is self-consistent, not double-counted.
excluded_from_this_cut.stockcons_terminated: 2 of 40 nq_corpact.stockcons rows have termaction='Y' with a real termdate -- the announced consolidation was later cancelled and never took effect; excluded, not promoted as confirmed.
excluded_from_this_cut.stockcons_missing_exdate: 3 further nq_corpact.stockcons rows (termaction='N', announced 2015/2023/2025) have a NULL exdate; excluded rather than backfilling a synthesized effective date.
excluded_from_this_cut.capitalraised: nq_capitalraised.capitalraised (159 rows) is not promoted: methodcode ('RI', 'PL', 'SO', ...) has no decode table anywhere in the mirrored schema. 'PL' superficially resembles the existing CorporateActionToolType 'placement' value, but promoting only 'PL' while leaving 'RI'/'SO'/etc. unlabeled would assert an interpretation of an undocumented 2-character code -- the same category of risk quote_snapshot's promotion explicitly declined for nq_unadjprice2.daily.status.
excluded_from_this_cut.other_corpact_tables: nq_corpact.namechange/mergetakeover/meetingnotice/auditorchange/boardlotchange/... are out of scope for this cut (no corporate-action-type mapping requested).

ratio_not_promoted.note: neither nq_corpact.stocksplit nor nq_corpact.stockcons has a numeric ratio column -- the ratio (e.g. '8 - for - 1') exists only inside particulareng/particularchi/particularsim free text. This promotion does not parse/derive a ratio number from that text (would be deriving structured data the vendor never gave in structured form, the same discipline financial_facts applied to free_cash_flow and quote_snapshot applied to nq_unadjprice2.daily.status). The vendor's own particulars text is promoted verbatim as `summary` instead; `terms.ratio` is never populated for split/consolidation live rows.

entity_scope_choice.rationale: financial_facts' Serving scope is only codes present in ANY finreport table (2777 of 18036), because its bank/insurance carve-out needs its own coverage marker distinct from true absence -- there is no comparable 'known but structurally out of scope' bucket for corporate actions (all four source tables are schema-agnostic; any listed instrument could appear in any of them). A corporate action is also a rare, transient event: for the ~16981 remaining real, listed instruments, 'no dividend/buyback/split/consolidation right now' is the default state for nearly the whole market, not an anomaly warranting a 404 not_found the same status code used for 'this instrument id does not exist'. Building the full 18036-instrument universe with an explicit coverage.status=unavailable marker (quote_snapshot's idiom) keeps that distinction, and lets CorporateActionsPanel render a calm EmptyPanel state (matching the pre-promotion synthetic panel's own zero-actions handling) instead of an error card.
